observations.behavior: Adds a new instance setting FLAG_EVALUATIONS_READS_FORCE_EVENTS, replacing the previous FLAG_EVALUATIONS_USAGE_TAB_FORCE_EVENTS. The setting now applies to all readers of $feature_flag_called, not just the Usage tab, and its behavior is documented in comments and help text.
